name: Default
shortDescription: Single-node Chroma vector database server for embeddings, documents and metadata search, with persistent storage behind a token-protected HTTP API.

alerts.message: There is no web UI. The Chroma server has no authentication of its own, so every request goes through a gateway that requires the generated CHROMA_TOKEN from the environment settings, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token> or X-Chroma-Token: <token>. In Python: chromadb.HttpClient(host="<your-domain>", port=443, ssl=True, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <token>"}).
